title: एकत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 31 · Second day under Karna: the arrays

summary.en: Karna sees the Pandava array and tells Shalya to show him Yudhishthira and the other heroes, and Shalya names the Pandava chiefs. Karna and Shalya exchange words as the armies meet, like the Ganga and Yamuna in flood.
summary.kn: ಪಾಂಡವರ ವ್ಯೂಹವನ್ನು ಕಂಡ ಕರ್ಣ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಮತ್ತಿತರ ವೀರರನ್ನು ತೋರಿಸಲು ಶಲ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಶಲ್ಯ ಪಾಂಡವ ನಾಯಕರನ್ನು ಹೆಸರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸೈನ್ಯಗಳು ಪ್ರವಾಹದ ಗಂಗೆ-ಯಮುನೆಯರಂತೆ ಸಂಧಿಸಲು ಕರ್ಣ-ಶಲ್ಯರು ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: पाण्डवों का व्यूह देखकर कर्ण शल्य से युधिष्ठिर और अन्य वीरों को दिखाने को कहता है और शल्य पाण्डव नायकों के नाम बताता है। बाढ़ में गंगा-यमुना की तरह सेनाओं के मिलने पर कर्ण-शल्य बात करते हैं।
summary.te: పాండవ వ్యూహాన్ని చూసి కర్ణుడు యుధిష్ఠిరుని, ఇతర వీరులను చూపమని శల్యునికి చెబుతాడు; శల్యుడు పాండవ నాయకులను పేర్కొంటాడు. వరదలో గంగా యమునల్లా సేనలు కలుస్తుండగా కర్ణ శల్యులు మాట్లాడుకుంటారు.
summary.ta: பாண்டவரின் வியூகத்தைக் கண்ட கர்ணன் யுதிஷ்டிரரையும் பிற வீரரையும் காட்டும்படி சல்யனிடம் கூற, சல்யன் பாண்டவத் தலைவர்களைப் பெயரிடுகிறான். வெள்ளத்தில் கங்கையும் யமுனையும் போல் படைகள் சந்திக்க, கர்ணனும் சல்யனும் உரையாடுகின்றனர்.
summary.ml: പാണ്ഡവവ്യൂഹം കണ്ട കർണ്ണൻ, യുധിഷ്ഠിരനെയും മറ്റു വീരന്മാരെയും കാണിക്കാൻ ശല്യനോട് പറയുന്നു; ശല്യൻ പാണ്ഡവനായകന്മാരുടെ പേരുകൾ പറയുന്നു. സേനകൾ ഏറ്റുമുട്ടുമ്പോൾ, കുത്തിയൊഴുകുന്ന ഗംഗയും യമുനയും പോലെ കർണ്ണനും ശല്യനും വാക്കുകൾ കൈമാറുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 8.31; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 29 2019

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
ततः परानीकभिदं व्यूहमप्रतिमं परैः ।
समीक्ष्य कर्णः पार्थानां धृष्टद्युम्नाभिरक्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, seeing the enemy's army-splitting formation, which none of his side could match, guarded by Dhrishtadyumna on the Pandavas' behalf,

verses.text:
प्रययौ रथघोषेण सिंहनादरवेण च ।
वादित्राणां च निनदैः कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: advanced with the rumble of chariots, lion-roars and the din of instruments, as if making the earth tremble.

verses.text:
वेपमान इव क्रोधाद्युद्धशौण्डः परंतपः ।
प्रतिव्यूह्य महातेजा यथावद्भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Trembling as if with anger, eager for battle, tormentor of foes, of great splendor, he drew up his counter-array properly, bull of the Bharatas,

verses.text:
व्यधमत्पाण्डवीं सेनामासुरीं मघवानिव ।
युधिष्ठिरं चाभिभवन्नपसव्यं चकार ह ॥

meaning.en: and shattered the Pandava host like Indra shattering the asuras; and in attacking Yudhishthira he kept him on his right.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
कथं संजय राधेयः प्रत्यव्यूहत पाण्डवान् ।
धृष्टद्युम्नमुखान्वीरान्भीमसेनाभिरक्षितान् ॥

meaning.en: Sanjaya, how did Radheya array against the Pandavas, the heroes led by Dhrishtadyumna and guarded by Bhimasena?

verses.text:
के च प्रपक्षौ पक्षौ वा मम सैन्यस्य संजय ।
प्रविभज्य यथान्यायं कथं वा समवस्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: Who were the wings and the flanks of my army, Sanjaya, and how were they divided and stationed in due order?

verses.text:
कथं पाण्डुसुताश्चापि प्रत्यव्यूहन्त मामकान् ।
कथं चैतन्महायुद्धं प्रावर्तत सुदारुणम् ॥

meaning.en: How did the sons of Pandu array against mine, and how did this dreadful great battle begin?

verses.text:
क्व च बीभत्सुरभवद्यत्कर्णोऽयाद्युधिष्ठिरम् ।
को ह्यर्जुनस्य सांनिध्ये शक्तोऽभ्येतुं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥

meaning.en: And where was Bibhatsu when Karna advanced on Yudhishthira? For who could approach Yudhishthira in Arjuna's presence?

verses.text:
सर्वभूतानि यो ह्येकः खाण्डवे जितवान्पुरा ।
कस्तमन्यत्र राधेयात्प्रतियुध्येज्जिजीविषुः ॥

meaning.en: Who, wishing to live, would fight the one who alone conquered all beings at Khandava long ago, except Radheya?

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
शृणु व्यूहस्य रचनामर्जुनश्च यथा गतः ।
परिदाय नृपं तेभ्यः संग्रामश्चाभवद्यथा ॥

meaning.en: Hear the arrangement of the array, how Arjuna went after entrusting the king to others, and how the battle came about.

verses.text:
कृपः शारद्वतो राजन्मागधश्च तरस्विनः ।
सात्वतः कृतवर्मा च दक्षिणं पक्षमाश्रिताः ॥

meaning.en: Kripa son of Sharadvat, the mighty Magadha king, and the Satvata Kritavarman took the right wing.

verses.text:
तेषां प्रपक्षे शकुनिरुलूकश्च महारथः ।
सादिभिर्विमलप्रासैस्तवानीकमरक्षताम् ॥

meaning.en: On their flank were Shakuni and the great warrior Ulûka, who guarded your army with cavalry bearing bright lances,

verses.text:
गान्धारिभिरसंभ्रान्तैः पार्वतीयैश्च दुर्जयैः ।
शलभानामिव व्रातैः पिशाचैरिव दुर्दृशैः ॥

meaning.en: with steady Gandharas and unconquerable mountain men, like swarms of locusts, like fearsome pishachas.

verses.text:
चतुस्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि रथानामनिवर्तिनाम् ।
संशप्तका युद्धशौण्डा वामं पार्श्वमपालयन् ॥

meaning.en: Thirty-four thousand unretreating chariot warriors, the Samshaptakas, eager for battle, guarded the left side.

verses.text:
समुच्चितास्तव सुतैः कृष्णार्जुनजिघांसवः ।
तेषां प्रपक्षः काम्बोजाः शकाश्च यवनैः सह ॥

meaning.en: Gathered by your sons, wanting to kill Krishna and Arjuna, their flank was the Kambojas and Shakas with the Yavanas.

verses.text:
निदेशात्सूतपुत्रस्य सरथाः साश्वपत्तयः ।
आह्वयन्तोऽर्जुनं तस्थुः केशवं च महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: At the charioteer's son's order they stood with chariots, horses and foot soldiers, challenging Arjuna and mighty Keshava.

verses.text:
मध्येसेनामुखं कर्णो व्यवातिष्ठत दंशितः ।
चित्रवर्माङ्गदः स्रग्वी पालयन्ध्वजिनीमुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Karna stationed himself armored in the middle of the army's front, with bright armor and armlets, wearing a garland, guarding the head of the host.

verses.text:
रक्ष्यमाणः सुसंरब्धैः पुत्रैः शस्त्रभृतां वरः ।
वाहिनीप्रमुखं वीरः संप्रकर्षन्नशोभत ॥

meaning.en: Guarded by your furious sons, that best of weapon-bearers, the hero, shone as he led the front of the host.

verses.text:
अयोरत्निर्महाबाहुः सूर्यवैश्वानरद्युतिः ।
महाद्विपस्कन्धगतः पिङ्गलः प्रियदर्शनः ।
दुःशासनो वृतः सैन्यैः स्थितो व्यूहस्य पृष्ठतः ॥

meaning.en: Dushasana, long-armed, with an iron elbow-length, bright as sun and fire, tawny and good-looking, sat on a great elephant's back and stood at the array's rear, surrounded by troops.

verses.text:
तमन्वयान्महाराज स्वयं दुर्योधनो नृपः ।
चित्राश्वैश्चित्रसंनाहैः सोदर्यैरभिरक्षितः ॥

meaning.en: After him, great king, came King Duryodhana himself, guarded by his brothers with varied horses and varied armor.

verses.text:
रक्ष्यमाणो महावीर्यैः सहितैर्मद्रकेकयैः ।
अशोभत महाराज देवैरिव शतक्रतुः ॥

meaning.en: Guarded by the mighty Madras and Kekayas together, he shone, great king, like Indra with the gods.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा कुरूणां च ये प्रवीरा महारथाः ।
नित्यमत्ताश्च मातङ्गाः शूरैर्म्लेच्छैरधिष्ठिताः ।
अन्वयुस्तद्रथानीकं क्षरन्त इव तोयदाः ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthama and the Kurus' great warrior-heroes followed, with ever-rutting elephants ridden by brave barbarians, streaming like rain clouds.

verses.text:
ते ध्वजैर्वैजयन्तीभिर्ज्वलद्भिः परमायुधैः ।
सादिभिश्चास्थिता रेजुर्द्रुमवन्त इवाचलाः ॥

meaning.en: With banners, pennants, blazing superb weapons and riders, they shone like wooded mountains.

verses.text:
तेषां पदातिनागानां पादरक्षाः सहस्रशः ।
पट्टिशासिधराः शूरा बभूवुरनिवर्तिनः ॥

meaning.en: Of those foot-soldiers and elephants, thousands of unretreating heroes with spears and swords were foot guards.

verses.text:
सादिभिः स्यन्दनैर्नागैरधिकं समलंकृतैः ।
स व्यूहराजो विबभौ देवासुरचमूपमः ॥

meaning.en: With cavalry, chariots and elephants splendidly adorned, that king of arrays shone like the army of gods and asuras.

verses.text:
बार्हस्पत्यः सुविहितो नायकेन विपश्चिता ।
नृत्यतीव महाव्यूहः परेषामादधद्भयम् ॥

meaning.en: Well made by a wise leader in the Brihaspati form, that great array seemed to dance, bringing fear to its foes.

verses.text:
तस्य पक्षप्रपक्षेभ्यो निष्पतन्ति युयुत्सवः ।
पत्त्यश्वरथमातङ्गाः प्रावृषीव बलाहकाः ॥

meaning.en: From its flanks and wings eager fighters rushed out, infantry, horses, chariots and elephants, like clouds in the rainy season.

verses.text:
ततः सेनामुखे कर्णं दृष्ट्वा राजा युधिष्ठिरः ।
धनंजयममित्रघ्नमेकवीरमुवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, seeing Karna at the head of the army, spoke to Dhananjaya, the slayer of enemies, the lone hero.

verses.text:
पश्यार्जुन महाव्यूहं कर्णेन विहितं रणे ।
युक्तं पक्षैः प्रपक्षैश्च सेनानीकं प्रकाशते ॥

meaning.en: "Arjuna, look at the great array Karna has made in the battle; the army shines, furnished with flanks and wings."

verses.text:
तदेतद्वै समालोक्य प्रत्यमित्रं महद्बलम् ।
यथा नाभिभवत्यस्मांस्तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् ॥

meaning.en: "Having looked at that great enemy force, devise a plan so that it does not overwhelm us."

verses.text:
एवमुक्तोऽर्जुनो राज्ञा प्राञ्जलिर्नृपमब्रवीत् ।
यथा भवानाह तथा तत्सर्वं न तदन्यथा ॥

meaning.en: Told so by the king, Arjuna said to him with folded hands: "All is as you say, not otherwise."

verses.text:
यस्त्वस्य विहितो घातस्तं करिष्यामि भारत ।
प्रधानवध एवास्य विनाशस्तं करोम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: "I will carry out the blow that is fitting against it, Bharata; the killing of its chief is its destruction, and that I will do."

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
तस्मात्त्वमेव राधेयं भीमसेनः सुयोधनम् ।
वृषसेनं च नकुलः सहदेवोऽपि सौबलम् ॥

meaning.en: "Then you yourself take Radheya, Bhimasena Suyodhana, Nakula Vrishasena, and Sahadeva the son of Subala."

verses.text:
दुःशासनं शतानीको हार्दिक्यं शिनिपुंगवः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नस्तथा द्रौणिं स्वयं यास्याम्यहं कृपम् ॥

meaning.en: "Shatanika shall take Dushasana, the bull of the Shinis Hardikya, Dhrishtadyumna Drona's son, and I myself will go against Kripa."

verses.text:
द्रौपदेया धार्तराष्ट्राञ्शिष्टान्सह शिखण्डिना ।
ते ते च तांस्तानहितानस्माकं घ्नन्तु मामकाः ॥

meaning.en: "Draupadi's sons with Shikhandi take the remaining Dhartarashtras; and let each of our men strike down their respective foes."

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
इत्युक्तो धर्मराजेन तथेत्युक्त्वा धनंजयः ।
व्यादिदेश स्वसैन्यानि स्वयं चागाच्चमूमुखम् ॥

meaning.en: Told so by the king of dharma, Dhananjaya said "So be it," gave orders to his own troops, and himself went to the head of the force.

verses.text:
अथ तं रथमायान्तं दृष्ट्वात्यद्भुतदर्शनम् ।
उवाचाधिरथिं शल्यः पुनस्तं युद्धदुर्मदम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Shalya, seeing that wondrous-looking chariot approach, spoke again to Adhiratha's son, who was mad for battle.

verses.text:
अयं स रथ आयाति श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः ।
निघ्नन्नमित्रान्कौन्तेयो यं यं त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: "This is the chariot coming, with white horses and Krishna as charioteer, the son of Kunti, slaying enemies, about whom you keep asking."

verses.text:
श्रूयते तुमुलः शब्दो रथनेमिस्वनो महान् ।
एष रेणुः समुद्भूतो दिवमावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: "A tumultuous noise is heard, the great rumble of chariot wheels; this dust has risen and stands covering the sky."

verses.text:
चक्रनेमिप्रणुन्ना च कम्पते कर्ण मेदिनी ।
प्रवात्येष महावायुरभितस्तव वाहिनीम् ।
क्रव्यादा व्याहरन्त्येते मृगाः कुर्वन्ति भैरवम् ॥

meaning.en: "The earth, pressed by wheel-rims, trembles, Karna; a great wind blows all around your army; these meat-eaters cry out and beasts make dreadful sounds."

verses.text:
पश्य कर्ण महाघोरं भयदं लोमहर्षणम् ।
कबन्धं मेघसंकाशं भानुमावृत्य संस्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: "Look, Karna, at the terrifying, fear-giving, hair-raising headless trunk like a cloud, standing and covering the sun."

verses.text:
पश्य यूथैर्बहुविधैर्मृगाणां सर्वतोदिशम् ।
बलिभिर्दृप्तशार्दूलैरादित्योऽभिनिरीक्ष्यते ॥

meaning.en: "Look at the herds of many kinds of beasts in all directions; the sun is gazed upon by strong and proud tigers."

verses.text:
पश्य कङ्कांश्च गृध्रांश्च समवेतान्सहस्रशः ।
स्थितानभिमुखान्घोरानन्योन्यमभिभाषतः ॥

meaning.en: "See the herons and vultures gathered in thousands, standing dreadfully face to face, speaking to each other."

verses.text:
सिताश्चाश्वाः समायुक्तास्तव कर्ण महारथे ।
प्रदराः प्रज्वलन्त्येते ध्वजश्चैव प्रकम्पते ॥

meaning.en: "Your white horses are yoked to your great chariot, Karna; your quivers blaze and your banner shakes."

verses.text:
उदीर्यतो हयान्पश्य महाकायान्महाजवान् ।
प्लवमानान्दर्शनीयानाकाशे गरुडानिव ॥

meaning.en: "See the horses rising, huge-bodied and swift, lovely to look at, flying in the sky like Garudas."

verses.text:
ध्रुवमेषु निमित्तेषु भूमिमावृत्य पार्थिवाः ।
स्वप्स्यन्ति निहताः कर्ण शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: "Surely, from these omens, kings will lie covering the earth, slain, Karna, by hundreds and thousands."

verses.text:
शङ्खानां तुमुलः शब्दः श्रूयते लोमहर्षणः ।
आनकानां च राधेय मृदङ्गानां च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: "The tumultuous, hair-raising sound of conches is heard, and of drums and mridangas everywhere, Radheya."

verses.text:
बाणशब्दान्बहुविधान्नराश्वरथनिस्वनान् ।
ज्यातलत्रेषुशब्दांश्च शृणु कर्ण महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: "Hear, Karna, the many sounds of arrows, the din of men, horses and chariots, and the twang of bowstrings and palm-guards of the great-souled."

verses.text:
हेमरूप्यप्रमृष्टानां वाससां शिल्पिनिर्मिताः ।
नानावर्णा रथे भान्ति श्वसनेन प्रकम्पिताः ॥

meaning.en: "Many-colored cloths, polished with gold and silver and made by craftsmen, gleam on the chariot, stirred by the wind."

verses.text:
सहेमचन्द्रतारार्काः पताकाः किङ्किणीयुताः ।
पश्य कर्णार्जुनस्यैताः सौदामिन्य इवाम्बुदे ॥

meaning.en: "See, Karna, those banners of Arjuna with gold, moon, stars and sun and with little bells, like lightning in a cloud."

verses.text:
ध्वजाः कणकणायन्ते वातेनाभिसमीरिताः ।
सपताका रथाश्चापि पाञ्चालानां महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: "The banners rattle as the wind moves them, and the pennanted chariots of the great-souled Panchalas as well."

verses.text:
नागाश्वरथपत्त्यौघांस्तावकान्समभिघ्नतः ।
ध्वजाग्रं दृश्यते त्वस्य ज्याशब्दश्चापि श्रूयते ॥

meaning.en: "The tip of his banner is seen, and the twang of his bowstring heard, as he strikes your hosts of elephants, horses, chariots and foot."

verses.text:
अद्य द्रष्टासि तं वीरं श्वेताश्वं कृष्णसारथिम् ।
निघ्नन्तं शात्रवान्संख्ये यं कर्ण परिपृच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: "Today you will see that hero with the white horses and Krishna as charioteer, killing enemies in battle, whom you keep asking about, Karna."

verses.text:
अद्य तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ लोहिताक्षौ परंतपौ ।
वासुदेवार्जुनौ कर्ण द्रष्टास्येकरथस्थितौ ॥

meaning.en: "Today, Karna, you will see those two tigers among men, red-eyed tormentors of foes, Vasudeva and Arjuna, standing in one chariot."

verses.text:
सारथिर्यस्य वार्ष्णेयो गाण्डीवं यस्य कार्मुकम् ।
तं चेद्धन्तासि राधेय त्वं नो राजा भविष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: "He whose charioteer is Varshneya and whose bow is Gandiva: if you kill him, Radheya, you will be our king."

verses.text:
एष संशप्तकाहूतस्तानेवाभिमुखो गतः ।
करोति कदनं चैषां संग्रामे द्विषतां बली ।
इति ब्रुवाणं मद्रेशं कर्णः प्राहातिमन्युमान् ॥

meaning.en: "He, called by the Samshaptakas, has gone to face them, and the strong one is slaughtering those foes in battle." Karna, in great anger, replied to the Madra king as he said this.

verses.text:
पश्य संशप्तकैः क्रुद्धैः सर्वतः समभिद्रुतः ।
एष सूर्य इवाम्भोदैश्छन्नः पार्थो न दृश्यते ।
एतदन्तोऽर्जुनः शल्य निमग्नः शोकसागरे ॥

meaning.en: "Look, Partha is attacked from all sides by the furious Samshaptakas, covered like the sun by clouds, and not seen. Here, Shalya, is the end of Arjuna, sunk in a sea of grief."

verses.text: शल्य उवाच

meaning.en: Shalya said:

verses.text:
वरुणं कोऽम्भसा हन्यादिन्धनेन च पावकम् ।
को वानिलं निगृह्णीयात्पिबेद्वा को महार्णवम् ॥

meaning.en: "Who could kill Varuna with water, or fire with fuel? Who could seize the wind or drink the great ocean?"

verses.text:
ईदृग्रूपमहं मन्ये पार्थस्य युधि निग्रहम् ।
न हि शक्योऽर्जुनो जेतुं सेन्द्रैः सर्वैः सुरासुरैः ॥

meaning.en: "I think Partha's defeat in battle would be of that sort. Arjuna cannot be conquered by all the gods and asuras together with Indra."

verses.text:
अथैवं परितोषस्ते वाचोक्त्वा सुमना भव ।
न स शक्यो युधा जेतुमन्यं कुरु मनोरथम् ॥

meaning.en: "If you are pleased only by saying so, then be content with words. He cannot be conquered in battle; set your hopes on something else."

verses.text:
बाहुभ्यामुद्धरेद्भूमिं दहेत्क्रुद्ध इमाः प्रजाः ।
पातयेत्त्रिदिवाद्देवान्योऽर्जुनं समरे जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: "One who could defeat Arjuna in battle could lift the earth with his arms, burn these creatures in anger, and cast the gods down from heaven."

verses.text:
पश्य कुन्तीसुतं वीरं भीममक्लिष्टकारिणम् ।
प्रभासन्तं महाबाहुं स्थितं मेरुमिवाचलम् ॥

meaning.en: "Look at the hero Bhima, son of Kunti, who does hard deeds effortlessly, shining, long-armed, standing like Mount Meru."

verses.text:
अमर्षी नित्यसंरब्धश्चिरं वैरमनुस्मरन् ।
एष भीमो जयप्रेप्सुर्युधि तिष्ठति वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: "Intolerant, always furious, remembering the old enmity, this mighty Bhima stands in battle, wanting victory."

verses.text:
एष धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
तिष्ठत्यसुकरः संख्ये परैः परपुरंजयः ॥

meaning.en: "Here is the best of those who bear dharma, Yudhishthira, king of dharma, conqueror of enemy cities, standing in the fight, hard for the enemy to handle."

verses.text:
एतौ च पुरुषव्याघ्रावश्विनाविव सोदरौ ।
नकुलः सहदेवश्च तिष्ठतो युधि दुर्जयौ ॥

meaning.en: "And here stand these two tigers among men, twin brothers like the Ashvins, Nakula and Sahadeva, hard to conquer in battle."

verses.text:
दृश्यन्त एते कार्ष्णेयाः पञ्च पञ्चाचला इव ।
व्यवस्थिता योत्स्यमानाः सर्वेऽर्जुनसमा युधि ॥

meaning.en: "Here are seen the five sons of Krishna, like five mountains, standing ready to fight, all equal to Arjuna in battle."

verses.text:
एते द्रुपदपुत्राश्च धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमाः ।
हीनाः सत्यजिता वीरास्तिष्ठन्ति परमौजसः ॥

meaning.en: "And these sons of Drupada, led by Dhrishtadyumna, and the heroes with Satyajit, of great energy, stand here."

verses.text:
इति संवदतोरेव तयोः पुरुषसिंहयोः ।
ते सेने समसज्जेतां गङ्गायमुनवद्भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: While those two lions among men were speaking so, the two armies clashed violently, like the Ganga and Yamuna.
